title: `name`
description: The identifier a downstream consumer uses to invoke the tool.
question: Is the tool name unchanged at each capture boundary?
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
known_issues: A prefixed name changes between server configurations, so a hard coded allowlist can silently stop matching.
why: Name based routing, allowlists, and eval fixtures that match exact tool names break under prefixing.

notes.mastra: Mastra 2.2.0: MCPClient.listTools namespaces every tool action as `<serverKey>_<toolName>`, so `delete_account` is handed to the agent as `src_delete_account`.
notes.langchain_js: LangChain.js (@langchain/mcp-adapters 2.0.1): `MCPAdapter` names every tool `<server>_<tool>` (one underscore since 2.0.1, two before), so the model sees `src_search_records` for the server's `search_records`. The prefix is the server key in `servers` and is on by default; the per-server `prefixToolNameWithServerName: false` option, which was not measured, removes it.
notes.copilot_sdk: GitHub Copilot SDK 1.0.19 (Copilot runtime 1.0.95): tools reach the model as `<server>-<tool>`, here `src-search_records`. The prefix is the key the host gives the server in `SessionConfig.mcpServers`.
